name: Benedictions
overview: Scripture reveals that benedictions are divinely appointed blessings pronounced by God or His representatives upon His creation, especially humanity. From the initial blessing of creation, where God commands creatures to be fruitful and multiply (Genesis 1:22, 1:28), to His blessing upon Noah and his sons to replenish the earth (Genesis 9:1-2), these blessings establish God’s sovereign provision and authority. Additionally, human agents such as Melchizedek and Abraham receive and pronounce blessings that acknowledge God's supremacy and deliverance (Genesis 14:19-20), highlighting the sacred nature of benedictions as declarations of God’s favor and power.
